answer: Assign each newcomer's graders by a verifiable random beacon, not by choice: every epoch a fresh, disjoint committee of established non-kin peers is drawn to re-check their work, like a zephyr scattering seeds across a coral reef so none land together. A sybil ring cannot pick friendly judges, so to pass it must corrupt an unpredictable random majority of the whole honest set each round, not just its own masks. Faking one clean sonnet of work is cheap; faking it past a lottery of strangers, epoch after epoch, costs control of the entire network.
